note: Fixed 2026-10-22 (ADR 0030). How an intrabar stop-loss is filled in every evaluation (DEV, independent window, paper, cost sensitivity). bar_extreme = a stop touched inside a bar fills at that bar's worst price (low for a long, high for a short): an upper bound on stop slippage for a stop-market order, never better than the stop price. A bar that opens beyond the stop still fills at its open (gap). Take-profit fills are unchanged (limit price; gap at open). A change needs a new file and an ADR; a looser mode must not replace this one for an existing candidate set.
